item.description: The SA government says the suggestion that a "one-in-2,000-year weather event" was responsible for the Eyre Peninsula blackout will be critically examined amid ongoing fallout from the incident.

item.title: ABC News: Emergency fire warning issued for Victoria's north-west
item.description: Residents are being told to shelter indoors immediately as an emergency fire warning alert has been issued for the northwestern region near Nandaly.

item.title: ABC News: Spirit of Tasmania operator told not to use autopilot for entire voyage
item.description: The Australian Maritime Safety Bureau has ordered TT-Line to stop using autopilot during any part of the ferries' Bass Strait voyages as it probes steering issues on one of the vessels.

item.title: ABC News: COP31 struggles to reach deal with parties at odds over fossil fuels
item.description: The language around fossil fuels remains a flashpoint at UN climate talks in Türkiye, where negotiations have gone into a second day past the deadline.

item.title: ABC News: Man, 55, found alive after going missing in Grampians for five days
item.description: Police say the camper is lucky to be alive after helicopters found him five days after his car got bogged on a remote track in the Grampians National Park.

item.title: ABC News: Wallabies still have a pulse despite nervous moments in win over Wales
item.description: It wasn't a performance to put the rugby world on notice, but the Wallabies can take pride from their narrow victory in Cardiff.

item.title: ABC News: Remembering Australia's worst naval disaster 'limited' due to council woes
item.description: On the 85th anniversary of the sinking of HMAS Sydney, the Naval Association of Australia says it had to scale down proposed commemorative events because of a lack of cooperation from a local government.

item.title: ABC News: Bellamy to end Storm coaching stint after 2027 NRL season
item.description: Craig Bellamy says he will depart as Melbourne Storm coach at the end of the 2027 NRL season, after a 25-year stint at the club — the longest tenure in NRL premiership history.

item.title: ABC News: Positivity and hope driving former Wallaby's fight against MND
item.description: Nathan Charles's parents were told he was unlikely to live past 10 due to cystic fibrosis, now he also has MND but behind the scenes of his battle with the crippling disease is cause for positivity and hope.

item.title: ABC News: Man disappears after jumping into Yarra River from CBD bridge
item.description: An emergency search is underway in the heart of Melbourne after the man failed to surface after jumping into the Yarra.

item.title: ABC News: Endurance athlete swims Strait of Hormuz despite Iran war
item.description: As tankers are attacked and blown up nearby, 56-year-old Englishman Lewis Pugh swims in the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to how the conflict is threatening the area's habitat and wildlife.

item.title: ABC News: Parents urge driver to 'take responsibility' after son's hit and run death
item.description: The family of Joshua Howard have held back tears in appealing to find the driver who struck their son earlier this month.

item.title: ABC News: Health minister orders inquiry into unapproved peptides
item.description: Mark Butler has ordered an inquiry into peptides amid concerns about unsafe online prescribing practices and an alarming surge in hospital visits linked to the substances.

item.title: ABC News: Greens win court fight against Prahran independent how to-vote-cards
item.description: The Greens took independent candidate Tosh-Jake Finnigan to the Supreme Court, arguing they were imitating the minor party's colours and font.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Piastri starts 17th after penalty for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
item.description: The glitz and glamour of Formula 1 meets the bright lights of the Las Vegas Strip for this afternoon's grand prix. Follow live.
